motion_and_effects.lenis_smooth_scroll: Enabled globally in App.js via Lenis instance

stagger_variants.child: initial: { y: 30, opacity: 0 }, animate: { y: 0, opacity: 1 }, transition: { duration: 0.6, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }

motion_and_effects.hover_interactions: Magnetic pill buttons, orb brightness pulse on hover, subtle 3D card perspective rotate
motion_and_effects.marquee: Infinite smooth CSS marquee loop with flex-row gap-12 pause-on-hover

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, links, tabs, and section containers MUST contain clear data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standards: WCAG AA compliant contrast ratio (minimum 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large display titles)
testing_and_accessibility.responsive_breakpoints: Mobile first design (sm: 640px, md: 768px, lg: 1024px, xl: 1280px)
